items.stem: The primary purpose of a board financial report is to:

options.text: Support the board's decisions with clear, relevant insight
options.rationale: Correct: board reporting exists to enable decisions, not to dump detail.

options.text: Show every transaction in full detail
options.rationale: Transaction-level detail overwhelms rather than informs the board.
Board packs supplement, not replace, statutory accounts.

options.text: Hide poor results behind long text
options.rationale: Reporting should be transparent, not obscuring.

items.explanation: Correct: board reporting exists to enable decisions, not to dump detail.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO practices make a variance analysis genuinely useful to a board? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Explaining the driver behind each significant variance
options.rationale: Correct: drivers turn a number into an actionable insight.

options.text: Focusing on material variances rather than every small line
options.rationale: Correct: materiality keeps attention on what matters.

options.text: Listing every variance regardless of size
options.rationale: This buries the signal in noise.

options.text: Omitting any variance that looks unfavourable

items.explanation: Correct: drivers turn a number into an actionable insight.

items.stem: Presenting a single-point forecast to the board as a certainty is risky mainly because:

options.text: It hides the uncertainty and range of plausible outcomes
options.rationale: Correct: a point forecast conceals risk; a range or scenarios is more honest.

options.text: Forecasts are never allowed in board papers
options.rationale: Forecasts are expected; the issue is presenting them as certain.

options.text: The board prefers no numbers at all
options.rationale: Boards need numbers, presented with their uncertainty.
The problem is false certainty, not a directional bias.

items.explanation: Correct: a point forecast conceals risk; a range or scenarios is more honest.
